verification_scope: local CPU; synthetic workflow only; not original paper experiment reproduction

default_profile.precision_mode: autocast; master weights and SSM state parameters remain FP32
default_profile.scope: batch=1, resident tensor -> model logits; excludes file I/O, preprocessing, transfer and postprocessing
default_profile.memory_scope: CUDA allocator current and peak allocated/reserved bytes; CPU/MPS memory not measured
default_profile.flops_scope: partial only: Conv2d and Linear multiply-adds at 2 FLOPs/MAC; excludes selective recurrence, einsum projections, scan indexing, normalization, activations, pooling and interpolation; not total model FLOPs
